_about: Every word on the base screen. Rule: max 12 words per sentence, max 2 sentences. {n}, {max} and similar are filled in by the game.

power.name: Power
power.explain: Power runs every machine. The Sun makes it.

air.name: Air
air.explain: Air means oxygen. The crew breathes it all day.

food.name: Food
food.explain: Food comes from the greenhouse. The crew eats every sol.

time.name: Time
time.explain: You get {n} time points each sol. Walking uses 1.

shield.name: Shield
shield.explain: The shield blocks radiation. Radiation is invisible energy that can hurt bodies.

dust.name: Dust
dust.explain: Dust on the panels blocks sunlight. Less sunlight means less power.

science.name: Science stars
science.explain: Stars show the science you did. They raise your score.

power.name: Power Room
power.about: Solar panels and the battery live here.

air.name: Air Room
air.about: This machine makes oxygen for the crew to breathe.

shelter.name: Shield Shelter
shelter.about: Thick walls keep the crew safe from radiation.

cleanPanels.name: Clean the panels
cleanPanels.about: Less dust means more power tomorrow.

makeOxygen.name: Make oxygen
makeOxygen.about: The machine turns power into air.

growLights.name: Turn on grow lights
growLights.about: Plants make food over the next 2 sols.

science.name: Do science
science.about: Study Mars and earn a star.

hud.solExplain: A sol is one day on Mars. It is about 40 minutes longer than Earth's day.
hud.gameSizedExplain: These numbers are made small for the game. Real bases use bigger numbers.

panel.tapRoom: Tap a room to walk there.

reasons.noTime: Not enough time. You need {n}, you have {have}.
reasons.notEnough: Not enough {stat}. You need {n}, you have {have}.
reasons.limit: Done for today. Try again next sol.

confirmNewGame: Start a new game? Your base will reset.
